name: Cessabit Cyclobenzaprine 10mg — 60 Tablets
short: Cessabit® cyclobenzaprine 10 mg, 60 tablets — centrally-acting muscle relaxant for short-term relief of muscle spasm. Available with prescription verification at CMC Pharmacy Cabo.
description:
Cessabit® is the Mexican brand of cyclobenzaprine 10 mg, a centrally-acting skeletal muscle relaxant indicated as an adjunct to rest and physical therapy for the short-term relief of muscle spasm associated with acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions. Each tablet contains cyclobenzaprine hydrochloride 10 mg, and this presentation includes 60 tablets.

Cyclobenzaprine is structurally related to tricyclic antidepressants and works primarily at the brainstem level rather than at the spinal cord or muscle itself. Treatment is typically limited to two to three weeks. Drowsiness is common; avoid driving or operating machinery until you know how this medication affects you. Consult your healthcare provider for appropriate use.

Available at CMC Pharmacy Cabo with bilingual service and fast hotel delivery throughout Cabo San Lucas and the corridor. Prescription Required. A valid medical prescription is needed to dispense this medication. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1).
